# The UI is a single hand-written HTML file, gzipped and compiled into the
# binary as src/ui_asset.c.
#
# That file is generated by tools/gen_ui_asset.py, wired in as a PlatformIO
# pre-build hook so it is refreshed on every build. It is deliberately NOT
# generated by a CMake rule:
#
#   * EMBED_FILES emits an assembly stub via a CMake custom command, and
#     PlatformIO's build layer never runs those -- the build then fails on a
#     file nobody produced.
#   * Generating at configure time does work, but PlatformIO does not re-run
#     configure when only the HTML changes. That failed silently: builds kept
#     succeeding while the firmware served a stale page.
#
# The fallback below only covers a first configure before the hook has ever run,
# so plain idf.py builds are not left without the file.

set(UI_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../www/index.html)
set(UI_C ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/ui_asset.c)

if(NOT EXISTS ${UI_C})
    message(STATUS "ui_asset.c missing, generating once from ${UI_SRC}")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env python3 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../tools/gen_ui_asset_standalone.py
                ${UI_SRC} ${UI_C}
        RESULT_VARIABLE gen_result
    )
    if(NOT gen_result EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not generate ${UI_C} (exit ${gen_result})")
    endif()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/Web.cpp" "src/ui_asset.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES app_config app_net app_mqtt esp_http_server mbedtls esp_timer app_update esp_app_format
)

target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
